description: Build an UNSIGNED transfer transaction (native coin or token) for a wallet the caller controls. Non-custodial: returns the unsigned transaction plus a pre-flight simulation (e.g. insufficient balance). Sign it locally, then call submit_signed. Chains: sol, eth, base, arbitrum, bsc.

amount.description: Amount in whole units as decimal string, e.g. "0.05"

token.description: Optional: usdc, usdt, or a token mint/contract address. Omit for the native coin.

name: build_send
